package domain

import "testing"

func TestNormalizeTaskLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	targets, err := NormalizeTaskLearningTargets([]TaskLearningTarget{
		{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: " learning.semantic-sequence ", Version: " v1 "},
		{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "program.instructions.sequence"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NormalizeTaskLearningTargets returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(targets) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("target count = %d, want 2", len(targets))
	}
	if targets[0].Key != "learning.semantic-sequence" || targets[0].Version != "v1" || targets[0].Order != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected first target: %+v", targets[0])
	}
	if targets[1].Key != "program.instructions.sequence" || targets[1].Order != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected second target: %+v", targets[1])
	}
}

func TestNormalizeTaskLearningTargetsRejectsInvalidAndDuplicateTargets(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		targets []TaskLearningTarget
	}{
		{name: "invalid type", targets: []TaskLearningTarget{{Type: "mastery", Key: "learning.sequence"}}},
		{name: "empty key", targets: []TaskLearningTarget{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: ""}}},
		{name: "unstable key", targets: []TaskLearningTarget{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "Learning Sequence"}}},
		{name: "long version", targets: []TaskLearningTarget{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "learning.sequence", Version: string(make([]byte, 129))}}},
		{name: "duplicate", targets: []TaskLearningTarget{
			{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "learning.sequence"},
			{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "learning.sequence"},
		}},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := NormalizeTaskLearningTargets(test.targets); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected validation error")
			}
		})
	}
}
